plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both parties at one month of Fees 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.3 and is far below a meaningful cap — likely material deviation. Read 21.2-21.4 together before scoring.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-gives indemnity ('every claim relating in any way to Customer's use'); no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears, though Sec 9.3 cross-references 'Section 20.5' remedies. Treat as missing Vendor indemnity plus an over-broad reverse indemnity.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term worldwide non-compete on Customer — direct hit. Note tension with Sec 12.3, which disclaims any non-compete; cite both.
Sec 2.2 (first of two 2.2s) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — deviation. Sec 12.3 disclaims exclusivity; flag the conflict and delete the exclusivity.
No MFN obligation on Customer found; Sec 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Confirm pricing sections 7.1 and 8.3 contain no MFN before marking absent/compliant.
No non-solicit binding Customer located; Sec 12.3 affirmatively preserves hiring from general recruitment and disclaims any no-hire commitment.

Sec 9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refunds and denies Vendor a matching right — favourable. Check interaction with Sec 2.1 take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights', but flag that overlap under MINCOMMIT to avoid double-counting.
Sec 8.2 gives 30-day non-renewal notice plus a reminder mechanic; Sec 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice. Likely compliant.
New York law, exclusive New York County courts, no arbitration — within accepted list; likely compliant.
Sec 24.1 permits Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent and 24.4 blocks Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control; likely compliant.
Customer owns Customer Data (14.1) and Deliverables assigned on creation subject to payment (14.2); Vendor Technology retained but licensed via 13.2. Direction favours us — likely compliant.

Sec 13.1 grants a licence to Customer alone, excludes Affiliates and contractors, and is revocable at Vendor's sole discretion — material deviation, notwithstanding the broader paid-up grant in 13.2 and the revocation limits in 13.3.
Sec 22.1-22.3 limit audits to once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, off-site where practicable, Vendor-borne cost with a 5% shortfall trigger — likely compliant.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer spotted; 7.3 bars interest on amounts not due and 9.4 says no penalty on convenience exit. Verify Sec 2.1 take-or-pay is treated under MINCOMMIT rather than here.
Sec 19.2 gives only a 15-day Deliverable warranty with no correction or refund duty thereafter — likely deviation on duration; weigh against the ongoing services warranty in 19.1 and remedy in 19.4.
Sec 18.1 sets CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O and USD 5M cyber cover with certificates and non-limitation language in 18.2 — likely compliant.

Sec 2.1 imposes USD 2M/year take-or-pay for three years 'without reduction or termination rights' — deviation; note the conflict with Sec 9.4 convenience termination and Sec 12.3's disclaimer of minimum-volume commitments.

Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export or migration support — deviation, and it contradicts the data-return and deletion sequence in 11.2-11.3; propose deleting 11.1 and adding a transition-services period.
